src/lib/persistence/effect/projectors-ef: Not a class token. The scanner reads any dotted string in a changed .ts file as one; this is a provider event type the turn projector stopped subscribing to, because a tool metadata update is not new work and must not reopen a settled turn.
src/lib/frontend/components/layout/Sessi: The bar's two flex bands became one CSS grid so the collapsed and expanded layouts can share a single DOM tree and the <h1> never unmounts. The same 3px/12px/6px padding and the flex-1 spacer are now `padding` and a `minmax(0, 1fr)` track on #session-bar in style.css. Not a `movedTo`: the destination is a stylesheet, and recipeTokens only reads quoted class literals.

Still on the title, now as `class:text-lg={!collapsed}` — the collapsed row shares its width with two 44px controls, so the title drops to text-base there, matching the mock's smallest state. The gate reports it because it does not read `class:` directives. Moving the size into style.css instead is a trap worth remembering: Tailwind v4 emits a theme variable only when a generated utility references it, so removing `text-lg` from the markup pruned --text-lg and the title silently rendered at the inherited 12px.
src/lib/frontend/components/session/Sess: conduit-test-vik1.2 replaced the row's three indicator dots (attention filled, unread outlined, processing pulsing) with one server-derived status word. The dots were client-side re-derivations of state the server now decides in one place, and three colours of 7px circle never said which of six things a row wanted. The appearance did not move to a recipe: it is gone, and the word carries the signal instead.

The fork glyph moved into the title line's declared 6px inline gap; its fixed 11px icon no longer needs a baseline offset or text-sized wrapper, and the former text-xs status and project text are text-sm now.

The old flex row's sizing, gap and padding moved into the two-line grid contract and its declared density classes. `group-hover:text-clip` did NOT move: it is still at the call site, on the inner title span, because style.css supplies the marquee animation but deliberately leaves the hover `text-overflow: clip` to whichever element owns the ellipsis.
The message count is gone from the row by design; the right column now shows either the status word or the time.
